title: Building Socio-culturally Inclusive Stereotype Resources with Community Engagement

bias_targets.methodology: Natural Language Inference (NLI) evaluations to measure entailment rates of stereotypical attributes associated with Indian state, regional, and ethnic identities, along with underlying text co-occurrence analysis.
